description: This file defines the 'Waiter' class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages polling an AWS resource until a desired state is reached or a failure condition occurs. It implements asynchronous waiting by producing promises and handles configuration for retries, delays, acceptors, and callbacks.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous waiter that polls AWS resources using configured acceptors, delays, and max attempts. It manages retries and state determination, producing a Promise that resolves or rejects based on the resource's state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Waiter with a client, name, command arguments, and configuration. Validates required config options and sets defaults.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coroutine-based promise that performs the wait operation, polling the resource until success or failure.

methods.name: getArgsForAttempt
methods.description: Prepares the command arguments for a specific attempt, including setting the delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Evaluates the result against acceptors to determine if the resource is in success, failure, or retry state.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if the result matches a specified path and expected value.

methods.name: matchesPathAll
methods.description: Checks if all values in a path match the expected value.

methods.name: matchesPathAny
methods.description: Checks if any value in a path matches the expected value.

methods.name: matchesStatus
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP or AWS response status code matches the expected value.

methods.name: matchesError
methods.description: Checks if the result is an AwsException matching the expected error code or connection error.
